_comment: Campaign kitchen kit (M1). Placed pieces cost credits and refund salvage when picked up empty. Sprites are regions of art/equipment.png. Prices per gram; energy is billed from the stove's burn at workshop.json balance.energy_price_per_kj.

items.name: Gas stove
items.note: Off, low 600 W, medium 1200 W, high 2000 W. Pans stand on top.

items.name: Sink
items.note: Tap water and a drain within reach; a pan stood in it sits in a cold bath.

items.name: Work table
items.note: Somewhere to stand molds and pans.

items.name: Candy mold · 800 g
items.note: Pour hot candy in; it sets below 45 °C.

items.name: Salt pan · 2 kg
items.note: Wide and shallow, for evaporating sea water slowly.
